fields.statement: internal/session/status_test.go TestResolvePrecedence passes (live reports: hook over Rex; once exited, the exit over hook and Rex); internal/api/session_test.go TestRecordRexExitIsFinal passes (a Rex working report, then Rex's child_exited removal, gives the exit, and later reports don't revive it) and TestSessionRun passes (a Rex working report then the agent's exit resolves to the exit, and a later hook is not recorded); cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/session-run.txtar passes

internal/session/store_test.go TestStoreWriteReadAtomic passes; internal/session/race_test.go TestStoreUpdateConcurrentWriters and TestStoreUpdateConcurrentProcesses pass under -race (a hook writer and a Rex writer make 200 updates each at once, as goroutines and as separate processes, and neither loses a report, since each update holds a per-record flock; without the lock both fail); internal/api/session_test.go TestSessionLsShow passes; cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/session-run.txtar shows the recorded status with rex removed

fields.quote: status precedence applies among a live session's reports. Once the process has exited, the exit is the status, and no earlier hook or Rex report outranks it. A hook or Rex report that arrives after the exit doesn't revive the session.
fields.quote_where: the orchestrator's fix brief for change set 3 (m2-cs3-fixes.md), item 1
